title: Implement Grouped-Query Attention
prompt:
Implement `grouped_query_attention(query, key, value) -> torch.Tensor` with PyTorch. These are already computed Q/K/V: query `[B, Hq, Tq, D]`, key/value `[B, Hkv, Tk, D]`. Query head h attends to KV head `h // (Hq // Hkv)`; Hq must be divisible by Hkv. Do not add learned projections, a mask, or a module API (the projected GQA exercise #390 covers those).

For every batch, query head, and query token, compute numerically stable scaled dot-product attention over Tk keys with scale `1 / sqrt(D)`. Return `[B, Hq, Tq, D]`. Inputs are finite float32/float64 tensors with matching dtype/device and representable scaled dot products. Convert array-like inputs with `torch.as_tensor` (non-floating inputs use the default floating dtype). Preserve dtype, device, and autograd to Q/K/V; do not mutate inputs or detach results.

Reject rank mismatches, zero dimensions, incompatible batch/head/token/feature sizes, dtype/device mismatches, and non-divisible head counts with `AssertionError`.
starter_code:

example.input: grouped_query_attention(q, k, v) where q has four heads and k/v each have one head
example.output: a tensor with four output heads
example.reasoning: All four query heads share the one key/value head while keeping their query-dependent attention weights separate.
